sources.title: Nippon Steel to spend $3 billion in U.S. Steel plant equipment upgrade, Nikkei reports
evidence: Nippon Steel (TYO: 5401) will invest about $3 billion in the U.S. Steel-operated Mon Valley works in Pennsylvania
to upgrade the plant's hot rolling facility, the Nikkei newspaper reported on Thursday.
The new equipment is set to enter operation in the second half of 2029, which would enable production of
The move is part of the Japanese steelmaker's pledge to invest $11 billion in U.S. Steel by 2028,

sources.title: Teck receives strike notice at Highland Valley Copper operation
evidence: Canadian miner Teck Resources (TSX: TECK.B) said on Wednesday it received strike notice from United Steelworkers Local 7619
The notice entitles the union to begin strike action as early as October 24, 8:00 a.m. PT, Teck said.
Operations continue at Highland Valley Copper, according to the miner.
The collective agreement at Highland Valley Copper expired on September 30.
